evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Every node in a multi-agent large language model (LLM) workflow retrieves context from memory and injects it into its prompt, where those injected tokens are billed as input tokens at the same per-token price as the system prompt and the user query.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We show the component is controllable at fixed model tier: reducing the retrieval window capacity from 32 to 2 entries lowers injected tokens by 28.7 percent with an accuracy change within seed-level variation.
